name: textarea
useFor: Use for free text longer than a line (Agent Description, a note, a message). Label it above like Input. It grows with its content; set rows or a min-h class to change the starting height.
constraints: A gray background for an editable value
A fixed height that hides what was typed
source: Figma 427:2715: Agent Description (Form- Input, 72px) in Create Agent Identity
title: Textarea
description: The field's 8px corners and lilac-gray edge around several lines of 14px text, 72px tall to start.
